# Cannot compute: country of production is missing

**Status: Not calculated, required input missing**

## Input check

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | 7201 (Pig iron) | ✅ Present |
| (b) Country of production | Not stated | ❌ **Missing** |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | 1,000 t | ✅ Present |

## Why no result is given

Under the ruleset, the default SEE is selected jointly by CN code and country. CN 7201 has three different default values in the table, so the factor depends on the country:

| CN code | Country | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Türkiye | 1.85 |
| 7201 | China | 1.66 |
| 7201 | India | 2.53 |

The ruleset says that if any required input is missing, no estimate should be made. Picking one of these factors, averaging them, or using the highest would all be estimates.

## Action required

Please give the **country of production** for the 1,000 t of pig iron. If it is Türkiye, China or India, I can calculate the embedded emissions right away. If it is another country, the table has no applicable default value, and the emissions cannot be calculated under this ruleset.
